name: MedCTA matched real OCR evidence and source policy v19
selection: first 6 of v18 reserved validation in original seeded order; no prediction or label used for selection; original remaining 6 validation and 68 confirmation not used; distinct image paths, patient/source independence unknown
policy: the single v18 policy generated only from 4 source trajectories and frozen before v18 development; no new policy generation or selection
arms: same fixed OCR evidence plus source policy
tool: real Tesseract once per case on current image; identical cached OCR provided to both OCR arms; no autonomous tool-selection claim; OCR failure stops before inference for that case
primary: all nonempty normalized whitelist phrases appear with token boundaries and no normalized blacklist phrase appears; conservative keyword proxy not semantic correctness or medical adjudication; gold read only after all 18 cells
secondary: strict normalized exact, paired gain/loss, OCR output length, calls, failures, cost
limits: 18 model calls, 2h original clock, own storage stop 100MB, per-host <50GB; no retries, no image/gold leakage; no GPU
public_boundary: no image, case ID, source policy, raw question, answer or model output
